title: CHAPTER 022 - Finalize v3.5 and hand over to v3.6
description: One complete automated handover chapter. READ/EVIDENCE verifies the exact v3.6 candidate and current v3.5 process; BACKUP preserves runners/state/helper; ONE LOGICAL CHANGE creates and arms a delayed handover helper; TEST validates helper syntax and confirms it is running. After v3.5 finalizes task 022 into state, the helper starts v3.6, verifies it is alive, then stops only the captured v3.5 PID. No manual PowerShell is required.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=Join-Path $root ('backups\022\'+$stamp); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null; foreach($name in @('3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1','3en-agent.state.json','switch-to-v36-022.ps1','3en-agent.log')){$src=Join-Path $root $name;if(Test-Path $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $bk $name) -Force}}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_022_BACKUP=PASS'

test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $helper='C:\3EN-Agent\switch-to-v36-022.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path $helper)){throw 'handover helper missing'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('HELPER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($err).Count); if(@($err).Count -ne 0){throw 'handover helper syntax invalid'}; $armed=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*switch-to-v36-022.ps1*' }); Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PROCESS_COUNT='+@($armed).Count); if(@($armed).Count -lt 1){throw 'handover helper is not running'}; Write-Host 'CHAPTER_022_PRE_FINALIZE_TEST=PASS'; Write-Host 'After FINALIZE, helper will verify state=022, start v3.6, verify it, and retire captured v3.5.'
